description: Canonical gas figures of the block-scoped ParticipationAwareHook. Overheads are gas with the hook minus the identical swap without a hook, each measured swap a cold transaction (forge test --isolate). Additional transaction = 21,000 + steady-state swap without a hook + hook overhead. Not used by any experiment yet; results/e7/gas_profile.json and hook_overhead_gas are unchanged.
swap_basis: cold single-range swap on a pool in steady state (Foundry test pool, measured inside the transaction)
usd_per_gas_source: P50 of C_gas_actual_usd in results/e7/tables/e7_smin_gas_conditions.csv / g_hat 180,214 (results/e7/smin_formula.txt): g_hat gas at each block's actual gas price and ETH price over all blocks of the study window
